movesets.name: Defensive Pivot
movesets.description:
Galarian Slowking utilizes its great bulk, Regenerator, and excellent defensive typing as a valuable slow defensive pivot that can bring its teammates in safely via Chilly Reception. Future Sight is used for its ability to apply immense delayed pressure onto targets like Pecharunt, Dondozo, and Clefable, which its teammates can take advantage of. However, Psychic Noise's immediate damage and ability to bypass Substitute can be used useful against Great Tusk, Zamazenta, and Substitute Iron Moth, and it also denies recovery from Gliscor. Psyshock is also a notable option, as it can help teams that are weak to Iron Moth while simultaneously pressuring opposing Galarian Slowking. Galarian Slowking's final moveslot can be used to patch up any noticeable difficulties against certain foes. Thunder Wave cripples Pokemon such as Kingambit, Dragapult, Darkrai, and Iron Crown, letting teammates take advantage of their lowered Speed. Toxic lets it put targets such as Raging Bolt, Ting-Lu, Alomomola, and Zamazenta on a timer. Flamethrower hits Steel-types such as Gholdengo and Kingambit, while Ice Beam targets Flying- and Ground-types such as Dragonite, Gliscor, and Landorus-T. Slack Off can grant Galarian Slowking additional longevity, let it take advantage of passive foes like Alomomola and Dondozo, and allow it to heal after forcing a switch. Heavy-Duty Boots is preferred to maximize Regenerator healing and help it stay healthy in longer games, letting it pivot around safely. However, teams with strong hazard control options can run Shuca Berry alongside Ice Beam to flip the matchup against Ground-types like Great Tusk, Landorus-T, and Gliscor. Other items such as Colbur Berry and Black Sludge can be used; the former makes it a better check to Knock Off users such as Iron Valiant and Rillaboom, while the combination of Trick + Black Sludge can cripple walls such as Garganacl, Ting-Lu, and Gliscor. A specially defensive EV spread lets it take on special attackers like Iron Valiant, Kyurem, Raging Bolt, and Enamorus more reliably. However, a physically defensive EV spread can also be used instead to take on Zamazenta, Ogerpon-W, and Rillaboom more easily. Tera Water is used to give it a better matchup against Walking Wake, Iron Moth, and Cinderace, while Tera Grass helps it against Great Tusk, Ogerpon-W, and Raging Bolt. Tera Fairy offers Galarian Slowking an improved matchup against Dragapult and Darkrai without gaining a weakness to Kyurem's Freeze-Dry.

Galarian Slowking can be found on a multitude of teams, ranging from bulkier balance to bulky offense, thanks to its ability to safely pivot in teammates while also providing excellent longevity and utility. Due to its pivoting capabilities, strong offensive wallbreakers are recommended alongside it to apply heavy pressure. As a result, Zamazenta is a great teammate, as Galarian Slowking can use Future Sight to help it threaten Pecharunt, Clefable, and Dondozo, while in return, Galarian Slowking appreciates it getting rid of Dark-types like Kingambit and Darkrai. Furthermore, the two form an excellent defensive backbone, as Zamazenta can check physical attackers like Kingambit, Hisuian Samurott, and Weavile, while specially defensive Galarian Slowking handles Fairy-types like Iron Valiant and Enamorus. Dark-types such as Kingambit, Weavile, and Darkrai benefit from Galarian Slowking's ability to check Fighting- and Fairy-types like Zamazenta and Primarina, while it appreciates the removal of Ghost-types such as Gholdengo and Dragapult. Galarian Slowking appreciates a teammate like Gliscor or Corviknight that can reliably switch into Knock Off, as it can struggle to switch in multiple times with entry hazards up without its Heavy-Duty Boots. Gliscor appreciates Galarian Slowking pivoting into Kyurem and Primarina, and Corviknight appreciates Galarian Slowking's ability to pivot into Iron Moth and Raging Bolt. In addition, both are able to switch into Ground-types like Great Tusk and Landorus-T that Galarian Slowking is threatened by. Fire-types such as Cinderace and Moltres are useful for dealing with Steel-types like Tinkaton and Gholdengo while also spreading burns onto physical attackers like Dragonite and Weavile, giving Galarian Slowking better entry points. Choice Specs Kyurem is a very notable teammate, as Chilly Reception not only grants Kyurem a Defense boost and a safe way to switch in but also gives it the option to use a strong Blizzard. Kyurem also likes Galarian Slowking handling Fairy-types such as Iron Valiant, Enamorus, and Primarina. Teammates like Ogerpon-W and Iron Valiant value Galarian Slowking switching into special attackers such as Iron Moth and Kyurem, as well as appreciating its ability to safely switch them in with Chilly Reception, opening up opportunities to repeatedly pressure foes. Additionally, physical attackers like the aforementioned Ogerpon-W and Dragonite benefit from Galarian Slowking's ability to pivot in on Pecharunt's Malignant Chain and pivot out after Pecharunt has pivoted makes it clearer, letting Galarian Slowking respond accordingly. If it is not running Heavy-Duty Boots, hazard removers such as Great Tusk and Iron Treads are appreciated, allowing Galarian Slowking to maximize Regenerator healing. Additionally, both appreciate Galarian Slowking checking special attackers like Primarina, Iron Moth, and Enamorus.

movesets.name: Assault Vest
movesets.description:
Assault Vest Galarian Slowking can blanket check hard-hitting special attackers like Walking Wake, Iron Valiant, and Enamorus, with Regenerator allowing it to maintain longevity throughout the course of a game. Moreover, the added bulk from Assault Vest means Galarian Slowking can afford to invest into its Special Attack, improving its offensive prowess significantly by making use of its colorful coverage options to be a respectable special attacker as well. Psyshock punches holes through special walls like opposing Galarian Slowking, Blissey, and Clodsire much more effectively than its other Psychic-type STAB options and also immediately threatens Iron Moth, which can snowball past Galarian Slowking if given enough turns. It also allows Galarian Slowking to handle threatening Calm Mind users like Raging Bolt and Iron Valiant that can otherwise break past it with enough boosts. Psychic Noise allows it to annoy walls like Garganacl and Gliscor while similarly threatening Iron Moth immediately, even doing so through its Substitute. Sludge Bomb's poison can prove devastating against bulkier foes like Alomomola and Ting-Lu that can otherwise switch into Galarian Slowking. Flamethrower is useful coverage to hit Steel-types like Kingambit and Gholdengo, which would otherwise have ample switch-in opportunities. Ice Beam allows Galarian Slowking to hit Ground-types like Gliscor, Landorus-T, and Great Tusk while denting foes like Dragapult and Dragonite. 8 Defense EVs let Galarian Slowking survive a Ceaseless Edge or Knock Off from Hisuian Samurott and 96 Special Defense EVs allow it to take two Choice Specs Kyurem's Earth Power. The rest of its EVs are pooled into Special Attack, letting it reach feats such as OHKOing Speed-boosting Iron Moth with Psyshock; 2HKOing Darkrai and OHKOing Rillaboom with Sludge Bomb; and 2HKOing Iron Crown and bulky variants of Gholdengo and Kingambit with Flamethrower. Alternatively, a physically defensive spread of 252 HP / 252 Def / 4 SpD with a Bold natute can be used to trade its offensive potency for a better matchup against mixed attackers like Deoxys-S and Iron Valiant and physical attackers like Zamazenta, Ogerpon-W, and Rillaboom all while still providing the team with a check to the aforementioned special threats. Tera Water gives Galarian Slowking a resistance to Water and Fire, allowing it to check Pokemon like Walking Wake, Primarina, and Iron Moth better, and drops its weaknesses to Dark- and Ghost-type moves, which allows it to act as an emergency check to Pokemon like Darkrai and Dragapult, and Great Tusk. Tera Grass similarly provides a Water resistance against Walking Wake with the added benefit of not being vulnerable to Garganacl's Salt Cure and Raging Bolt. The Ground resistance can also be helpful against foes like Great Tusk, Landorus-T, and Gliscor.

Galarian Slowking is a recommended pick for balance and bulky offense teams due to it being able to check multiple top metagame threats like special attacking Iron Valiant, Iron Moth, and Walking Wake while also having respectable offensive presence and respectable longevity. It has a lot of trouble dealing with Ground-type Pokemon like Great Tusk and Landorus-T, so Flying-types like Corviknight and Skarmory pair extremely well with it. Corviknight and Skarmory are also able to sponge physical attacks from other Pokemon Galarian Slowking struggles with like Weavile, Dragonite, and Kingambit. Offensive partners like Rillaboom and Primarina can hit Ground-types instead of just simply walling them. Great Tusk itself is a great teammate for Galarian Slowking on the balance teams they fit on, serving as a Kingambit check and as entry hazard removal, especially versus hazard stacking teams. In return, Galarian Slowking is able to beat Pokemon like Enamorus, Walking Wake, and special attacking Iron Valiant sets for Great Tusk. Dragapult pairs neatly with Galarian Slowking, since it's also a frequent balance pick, serves as useful speed control, and appreciates Galarian Slowking being able to spread poison thanks to Sludge Bomb, allowing it to fire off Hex more frequently late-game without fearing Fairy-types stopping its sweeps. Gliscor fits on balance builds with Galarian Slowking, serving as a blanket check to physical attackers, a hazard setter, and a Knock Off absorber, along with having great longevity. Galarian Slowking is able to take advantage of the hazards Gliscor sets up by forcing switches with its vast array of coverage options, since many offensive threats prone to taking hazard damage like Primarina, Enamorus, Iron Valiant, and Raging Bolt don't want to stay in and take repeated hits from it. Landorus-T is the Ground / Flying teammate of choice on bulky offense teams because of its better offensive presence and pivoting capabilities. Hisuian Samurott is another hazard setter that pairs well with Galarian Slowking, since it's able to soft check Pokemon that threaten Galarian Slowking like Weavile, Gholdengo, and Kingambit, whereas Galarian Slowking can take on Iron Valiant and Serperior for it while still retaining a threatening offensive presence thanks to its great coverage and solid offensive stats. Zamazenta is a great partner on bulky offense teams due to its favorable Kingambit matchup and ability to soft check many other physical attackers that threaten Galarian Slowking like Meowscarada, Ogerpon-W, and Weavile. IronPress sets can set up and sweep after Galarian Slowking has removed their checks and chipped the opposing team into KO range. Various other offensive Pokemon such as Primarina, Kingambit, and Ogerpon-W also greatly appreciate Galarian Slowking functioning as a defensive Pokemon with a notable offensive presence, allowing for more flexibility when teambuilding. Other bulky Regenerator Pokemon like Alomomola and Hydrapple can form Regenerator cores with Galarian Slowking, outlasting many offensive builds while covering each other's weaknesses. Alomomola can wall Fire- and Ground-types like Cinderace, Heatran, and Great Tusk, while Hydrapple is able to beat Water-types like Ogerpon-W, Hisuian Samurott, and Dondozo.

strategies.comments:
Other Options

Poison (Specially Defensive)

Shuca Berry can be an alternative held item to allow Galarian Slowking to survive a Ground-type attack that would otherwise KO it such as a +2 Landorus's Earth Power or Choice Scarf Landorus-T's Earthquake from full health and OKHO in response with Ice Beam.

movesets.name: Specially Defensive (Poison)
movesets.description:
With a pair of Heavy-Duty Boots, Galarian Slowking can provide itself with an entry hazard immunity while still preforming its role as a special tank for Poison teams, capable of switching into threats like Choice Specs Latios. Future Sight can handle threats such as Toxapex, Pecharunt, and Great Tusk that can prove problematic for Poison teams and helps to break stalemates against more passive teams. Ice Beam hits Flying- and Dragon-type threats such as Landorus, Zapdos, Enamorus, and Latios. Chilly Reception allows Galarian Slowking to pivot in frail teammates such as Sneasler and Iron Moth safely and, when paired with Future Sight, allows for said teammates to get through checks such as Toxapex and Clodsire, respectively. Alternatively, Toxic can pressure threats such as Raging Bolt and Volcarona, while Thunder Wave provides a speed control option for Poison teams against Pokemon such as Tornadus-T.

Sneasler and Okidogi appreciate Galarian Slowking pivoting them in with Chilly Reception and using Future Sight to nail would-be checks in Toxapex, Hippowdon, and Rotom-W. In return, Sneasler and Okidogi can remove special walls and Dark-types like Hisuian Goodra, Alolan Muk, and Hisuian Samurott. Iron Moth appreciates Galarian Slowking giving it safe switches with Chilly Reception, and its Future Sight support allows Iron Moth to break past special walls such as Clodsire; In return, Iron Moth can handle threats like Gholdengo, Metagross, and Sinistcha. Amoonguss provides a solid answer to powerful physical Water- and Ground-type threats like Barraskewda, Urshifu-R, and Great Tusk. Pecharunt's high Defense allows it to take on threats like Azumarill, Iron Hands, and Kleavor, along with using Parting Shot to create a bulky pivot core with Galarian Slowking. Thanks to levitate and its Fairy typing, Galarian Weezing provides a solid check to Dragon-, Ground-, and Dark-type threats such as Roaring Moon, Garchomp, and Ting-Lu, along with providing Defog support, should Galarian Slowking lose its Heavy-Duty Boots. Alolan Muk helps to check special Ghost- and Psychic-types that threaten to overwhelm Galarian Slowking such as Flutter Mane, Spectrier, Indeedee, and opposing Galarian Slowking. Overqwil can check physical Ghost- and Psychic-type threats such as Ceruledge, Dragapult, and Gallade, and it can set Spikes to pressure threats attempting to switch into Galarian Slowking's attacks such as Gholdengo. Clodsire can provide Stealth Rock support and can take on special threats such as Raging Bolt and Flutter Mane that can overwhelm Galarian Slowking.

movesets.name: Assault Vest (Poison)
movesets.description:
Galarian Slowking is a solid defensive piece for Poison teams with its incredible Special Defense, especially with an Assault Vest, able to shrug off hits from threats such as Heatran, Latios, and Raging Bolt. Future Sight is used to create pressure and helps to break opposing teams by nailing threats like Toxapex, Great Tusk, and Amoonguss that may want to switch in against Galarian Slowking's physical teammates like Sneasler and Okidogi for high amounts of damage. Sludge Bomb gives a much more consistent STAB option and helps to nail Fairy-type threats like Enamorus, Iron Valiant, and Primarina. Ice Beam stops threatening Dragon- and Flying-type threats like Latias, Raging Bolt, and Landorus. Flamethrower serves as a solid coverage option, melting problematic Steel-types like Corviknight, Skarmory, and Gholdengo that can otherwise shrug off Galarian Slowking's attacks, along with acting as a lure for Heatran. Finally, Earthquake gives Galarian Slowking a good way to break Heatran, which Poison teams detest, once its Air Balloon pops.

Sneasler and Okidogi benefit from Galarian Slowking immensely, as they can deal with threats attempting to take Galarian Slowking's Future Sights like Articuno, Blissey and Alolan Muk thanks to their high-powered Fighting-type STAB moves. Galarian Slowking, meanwhile, benefits from them removing dangerous Dark-type threats like Ting-Lu, Bisharp, and Hisuian Samurott. Amoonguss complements Galarian Slowking by being a physical wall capable of handling physical attacks from the likes of Great Tusk and Iron Treads with its Grass-type STAB moves and Foul Play, along with creating openings with Spore so Galarian Slowking can pivot in to heal and set Future Sight. Galarian Weezing provides similar support thanks to Levitate and its ability to handle threats like Garchomp, Dragonite, and Mamoswine with Strange Steam and Will-O-Wisp as well as remove entry hazards thanks to Defog. Toxapex completes the Regenerator core while also handling high-powered physical attacks from the likes of Scizor, Chien-Pao, and Ceruledge. Alolan Muk handles Ghost- and Psychic-type threats attempting to overwhelm Galarian Slowking like Flutter Mane, Spectrier, and Latias with Knock Off. Overqwil, with its far higher physical bulk and Intimidate, checks physical Ghost- and Psychic-type threats such as Ceruledge and Iron Boulder and sets Spikes to make Galarian Slowking's answers, Alolan Muk and Hisuian Goodra, take considerable chip damage. Iron Moth enjoys Galarian Slowking's ability to handle Heatran, which allows it to deal with the Steel-types like Corviknight and Gholdengo that would otherwise sit on Galarian Slowking and use its lacking Flamethrower as setup bait, along with melting Chien-Pao and Iron Treads if it is using a Choice Scarf. Salazzle similarly appreciates the removal of Heatran and helps out Galarian Slowking by inflicting Toxic onto special walls such as Hisuian Goodra and Alolan Muk with Corrosion, putting them on timers. Glimmora provides similar Toxic support with Corrosion while also setting entry hazards, chipping at switch-ins like Alolan Muk, Ting-Lu, and Hisuian Goodra when they come to stop Galarian Slowking.

movesets.name: Specially Defensive (Psychic)
movesets.description:
Galarian Slowking finds a niche on Psychic teams thanks to its incredible solid Special Defense and strong support moves such as Toxic Spikes. Sludge Bomb can spread Poison along with dealing with Fairy-type threats like Primarina and Enamorus. Ice Beam deals with Flying- and Dragon-type threats such as Zapdos, Tornadus-T, Latios, and Raging Bolt. Chilly Reception allows Galarian Slowking to safely pivot into its teammates. Finally, Thunder Wave slows down faster targets such as Volcarona and Greninja, allowing a teammate to comfortably remove them. Heavy-Duty Boots allows Galarian Slowking to safely come in; however, Black Sludge can be used to gain passive recovery.

Slowbro is a solid partner for Galarian Slowking, providing a Regenerator core for Psychic teams, with Slowbro being able to take on physical threats like Great Tusk, Barraskewda, and Cinderace, which threaten Galarian Slowking, while Galarian Slowking handles foes such as Primarina and Zapdos. Latios and Iron Boulder appreciate Galarian Slowking's Chilly Reception to safely pivot them in against threats like Kyurem and Iron Moth. Meanwhile, Galarian Slowking appreciates Latios removing threats such as Landorus, Garchomp, and Overqwil, along with Choice Scarf Iron Boulder emoving threats like Flutter Mane, Volcarona, and Tyranitar. Hoopa-U is appreciated for its ability to handle Ghost-type threats like Gholdengo, Spectrier, and Hisuian Zoroark and can use Knock Off to remove Heavy-Duty Boots from foes like Blissey to make Galarian Slowking's Toxic Spikes more potent. Galarian Slowking appreciates Hatterene's ability to block entry hazards along with its ability to take on Dark-type threats such as Hydreigon and Hisuian Samurott.

strategies.outdated: This analysis was for Battle Stadium Singles Regulation D, which ended on September 30th, 2023. Since then, this Pokemon's viability has massively dropped off, and it is no longer relevant. Using this Pokemon in today's metagame is not advised unless you have an extremely niche, hyper-specific need to cover.

movesets.name: AV Tank
movesets.description:
• Thanks to its great Special Defense, unique typing, and Regenerator, Galarian Slowking functions well as an Assault Vest user.

  • Assault Vest: While Galarian Slowking has access to Slack Off, Regenerator can provide some recovery if needed, and an Assault Vest increases its Special Defense to titanic levels.

  • Future Sight: Future Sight is Galarian Slowking's strongest move and provides phenomenal field pressure due to hitting two turns after it's used, allowing for combinations with another teammate's move.

  • Eerie Spell versus Psychic: Psychic offers more PP, while Eerie Spell depletes the PP of the last move used by the opponent by 3, which can be useful when fighting against opponents with low PP moves, such as recovery moves.

  • Acid Spray: Acid Spray makes Galarian Slowking much less passive and prone to setup against opponents that aren't immune, and the Special Defense drops can be deadly when combined with Future Sight, alongside making Galarian Slowking harder to check defensively.

  • Earthquake: Earthquake is Galarian Slowking's best option against Heatran and Hisuian Goodra, even when using a Calm nature.

  • Ice Beam: Ice Beam allows Galarian Slowking to hit Ground-types such as Ting-Lu, Landorus-T, and Ursaluna for more damage than its Psychic STAB moves.

  • Flamethrower: Flamethrower hits other Steel-types such as Gholdengo and Corviknight.

  • Calm versus Sassy: If using Earthquake, a Sassy Nature lets Galarian Slowking have a shot at 3HKOing max HP Hisuian Goodra, though at the risk of getting outsped by Amoonguss. A Calm Nature has better odds at Speed tying or outspeeding Amoonguss.

Other Options
  • Psyshock: Despite having little synergy with Acid Spray, Psyshock hits Flutter Mane and Clodsire the hardest before factoring Special Defense drops.
EV Spreads

  • 252 HP / 252 SpD / 4 Spe with Calm / Sassy: This EV spread focuses on Galarian Slowking's ability to take special attacks to the point where powerful super effective hits such as Choice Specs Flutter Mane's Shadow Ball only has a chance of 2HKOing it 75.4% of the time.

  • 252 HP / 28 Def / 84 SpA / 140 SpD / 4 Spe with Modest / Quiet: This spread survives Jolly Choice Band Urshifu-R's Surging Strikes while OHKOing it with Eerie Spell.

Tera Types

  • Tera Dependency - Low: Galarian Slowking is perfectly able to function without Terastallization, but it can boost its defensive profile.

  • Normal: A well-timed Tera Normal can severely hamper opponents hoping to take down Galarian Slowking with Ghost-type moves.

  • Poison: Tera Poison removes Galarian Slowking's weaknesses to Ghost-, and Dark-type attacks, and it boosts Sludge Bomb and Acid Spray's power.

  • Grass: Tera Grass turns Galarian Slowking's Ground weakness into a resistance, can help it take Urshifu-R's Surging Strikes better, and provides a handy immunity to Spore.

strategies.comments:
Other Options

A set utilizing an Assault Vest maximizes Galarian Slowking's special bulk and allows it to run more coverage options such as Flamethrower and Ice Beam, but Chilly Reception has far too many applications to pass up, and the lack of Heavy-Duty Boots makes Galarian Slowking far more susceptible to being worn down by hazards. All of the aforementioned attacks can be run over Scald or Thunder Wave to catch foes off guard, but the utility the latter two provide is usually preferred. A physically defensive set allows Galarian Slowking to more effectively check Hemogoblin, but other bulky Poison-types like Venomicon and Pecharunt simply perform that role much better.

Checks and Counters

Ground-types: Ground-types like Great Tusk, Gliscor, Equilibra, and Landorus-T can force Galarian Slowking out while switching into Sludge Bomb and Thunder Wave with little fear. None of them appreciate being burned by Scald, however.

Knock Off: Because Galarian Slowking often does not have reliable recovery outside of Regenerator, Knock Off makes it susceptible to hazards and thus, much easier to chip. Foes like Arghonaut, Gliscor, Ogerpon-W, and Roaring Moon can threaten massive damage with Knock Off, forcing Galarian Slowking out. None of them barring Gliscor want to switch into Sludge Bomb, however. Similarly, the threat of Knock Off often dissuades Galarian Slowking from switching into the likes of Malaconda, Pelipper, Deoxys-S, and Clefable, despite having an otherwise favorable matchup.

Dark-types: Darkrai, Kingambit, Meowscarada, and Weavile all threaten Galarian Slowking with their Dark-type STAB moves, but they must be careful when switching into it in fear of Thunder Wave and Scald.

Colossoil: Colossoil, albeit rare, is the closest thing to a hard counter for Galarian Slowking, threatening it with both its Dark- and Ground-type STAB options, not fearing any status ailments and resisting Sludge Bomb.

Ghost-types: Dragapult and Gholdengo both are bulky enough to be able to switch into Dragapult with ease and threaten it out with a Ghost-type attack. Gholdengo even has access to Recover, allowing it to switch into Scald without much worry. Kitsunoh can come in on any move, barring Scald, and force Galarian Slowking out. Revenankh similarly forces it out, but it must be much more careful as to when it comes in while fearing Psychic Noise, Scald, and Thunder Wave.

Garganacl: Garganacl cannot immediately threaten Galarian Slowking but can switch into any of its attacks rather trivially and put pressure on it with Salt Cure.

Strong Physical Attackers: Ogerpon-W, Choice Band Hemogoblin, Dragonite, and Miasmaw can all deal heavy damage on Galarian Slowking and force it out. None of them like the threat of being statused, however.

movesets.name: Defensive Pivot
movesets.description:
Set Details

Galarian Slowking provides a unique function in the metagame by being the best anti-weather option. Its incredible special bulk, decent defensive typing, and access to Regenerator also allow it to function as a very effective slow and bulky pivot. The combination of Future Sight and Chilly Reception allows it to not just safely bring in a teammate but also hammer them with a delayed attack, leaving the foe in an uncomfortable position. Pokemon like Zamazenta, Iron Valiant, Mollux, and Venomicon all struggle to take a Future Sight and often give Galarian Slowking the space it needs to set up its Future Sight. Psychic Noise is an alternative that helps shut down the recovery options that bulky foes such as Gliscor, Arghonaut, and Garganacl have. It also acts as a way to immediately damage Arghonaut, Chuggalong, Venomicon, and Zamazenta. Thunder Wave allows Galarian Slowking to cripple common switch-ins such as Dragapult, Darkrai, Roaring Moon, and Miasmaw. Scald is an alternative option, threatening the Ground-types that might attempt to switch into Sludge Bomb such as Equilibra, Great Tusk, and Gliscor, the latter even more so if its Poison Heal has yet to be activated. Scald also punishes other foes that might try to switch in such as Zamazenta, Revenankh, and Snaelstrom. Slack Off is another option in this slot, providing reliable recovery at the cost of some versatility or coverage. Heavy-Duty Boots allows Galarian Slowking to come into a field riddled with entry hazards without much to worry about, whereas Colbur Berry gives Galarian Slowking a chance to punish foes such as Swords Dance Iron Valiant, Darkrai, Arghonaut, and Knock Off Venomicon. Tera Water makes Galarian Slowking that much sturdier into weather teams, allowing it to heck foes such as Walking Wake, Roaring Moon, and Barraskewda more effectively. This also rids it of its pesky Dark-type weakness, allowing it to threaten Malaconda in sun matchups without fearing Knock Off as much. Tera Fairy is an alternative so as to turn its weakness to Dark into a resistance while also turning it into a decent switch-in against Dragon-types such as Dragapult, Raging Bolt, and Roaring Moon. 16 Defense EVs allow Galarian Slowking to survive a Knock Off from Meowscarada while the rest of the EVs are put into its Special Defense to make it as tanky as possible on the special side.

Galarian Slowking fits best on balance and bulky offense teams, where it can support heavy-hitting teammates. Frail but strong attackers such as Hisuian Samurott, Weavile, and Cinderace all appreciate Galarian Slowking bringing them in with relative ease. All of them also pressure physically frail foes while inviting specially frail ones, pairing ever so nicely with Galarian Slowking's Future Sight. Galarian Slowking also appreciates entry hazard support, as its Future Sight forces foes to switch out at inopportune times. Teammates such as Arghonaut, Gliscor, and Heatran all pair quite nicely by covering Galarian Slowking's weaknesses while setting entry hazards. The former two even have access to Knock Off, making every foe's switch-in costly. Gliscor can even act as a Knock Off switch-in once its Poison Heal has activated, keeping Galarian Slowking's item slot intact. Kyurem is one the biggest benefactors of Galarian Slowking's slow pivoting; not only does Galarian Slowking's Future Sight help it break through common revenge killers such as Iron Valiant and Zamazenta and sturdy checks such as Arghonaut and Mollux alike, but its Chilly Reception enables Choice Specs Kyurem to run Blizzard for extra firepower. Equilibra is another good teammate, covering Galarian Slowking's Ground-type weakness while Galarian Slowking can switch into Fighting-type attacks for it. They can also both use delayed attacks with Equilibra's Doom Desire, keeping an unending barrage of damage going, even while double switching. Cresceidon provides a fantastic partner, being able to beat most Ground- and Dark-types that threaten Galarian Slowking, such as Great Tusk and Landorus-T as well as Darkrai, Kingambit, and Weavile. In return, Galarian Slowking can switch into some of the foes that aim to pester Cresceidon such as Mollux, Garganacl, Iron Moth, and Heatran. On bulkier teams, Hydrapple and Alomomola can make nice Regenerator cores with Galarian Slowking, allowing them to switch nigh indefinitely with proper prediction while Future Sight slowly chips at the opposing team. Both of them also deal with any Ground-type attacks thrown in Galarian Slowking's way, with Hydrapple in particular being notable, as it can check Ogerpon-W, a foe that Galarian Slowking often struggles with.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Late round 2 onwards

Price Range: 14-15 points

Overview: Galarian Slowking is a great defensive pivot that enables the offensive threats on your draft. The combination of Galarian Slowking's great typing, good bulk, and Regenerator allow it to tailor its sets to check a large variety of offensive Pokemon. Its respectable base 110 Special Attack and wide array of coverage moves allow it to threaten said offensive Pokemon; however, the prevalence of strong Dark- and Ground-types in the current metagame means that it's unlikely an opponent's draft will have no ways of breaking past Galarian Slowking.

Common Roles

Bulky Pivot: Galarian Slowking's good mixed bulk and defensive typing allow it to check strong special wallbreakers while threatening them with its STAB moves or coverage options. The combination of Future Sight and Chilly Reception also allows Galarian Slowking to pivot into strong wallbreakers and pressure their checks while staying healthy thanks to Regenerator.

Setup Wallbreaker: Galarian Slowking can utilize Nasty Plot or Calm Mind to act as a strong wallbreaker against more defensively-oriented teams using its STAB moves and coverage options. Galarian Slowking can also use Iron Defense to survive hits from more offensive teams and strike back with its naturally good Special Attack.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Sludge Bomb, Sludge Wave, Psychic, Psyshock, Future Sight, Psychic Noise

Setup Moves: Nasty Plot, Calm Mind, Iron Defense

Utility Moves: Chilly Reception, Toxic, Trick, Thunder Wave, Yawn, Toxic Spikes, Slack Off, Trick Room, Light Screen, Taunt

Coverage: Fire Blast, Flamethrower, Focus Blast, Foul Play, Grass Knot, Hex, Hydro Pump, Ice Beam, Icy Wind, Power Gem, Earthquake, Scald, Surf, Shadow Ball

Niche Moves

Stored Power: Galarian Slowking's setup moves such as Iron Defense and Calm Mind, alongside its good natural bulk, allow it to live some super effective hits to activate Weakness Policy and sweep with Stored Power.

Chilling Water and Snarl: These moves can be used to allow Galarian Slowking to live hits from opposing wallbreakers or prevent them from setting up in front of it when no other better coverage options are available.

Psych Up: Psych Up allows Galarian Slowking to potentially beat some setup sweepers like Volcarona.

Common Items

Heavy-Duty Boots: Entry hazards limit Galarian Slowking's ability to consistently check opposing offensive pokemon, so Heavy-Duty Boots are a great way to avoid them and maximize Regenerator recovery while pivoting.

Black Sludge / Leftovers: Galarian Slowking can utilize Black Sludge on setup sets where it does not expect to switch many times throughout the match, or on Trick sets to cripple opposing Pokemon. If Galarian Slowking is a Tera user, Leftovers is the preferred item.

Assault Vest: Galarian Slowking's Regenerator allows it to utilize Assault Vest very effectively to be a strong check to opposing special attackers, or to invest more EVs into Defense or Special Attack without sacrificing its special bulk.

Resistance Berries: Galarian Slowking's wide range of strong coverage options and good bulk allow it to use a large variety of resistance berries to lure and eliminate or cripple specific threats on an opponent's draft.

Niche Items

Rocky Helmet: Galarian Slowking can utilize Rocky Helmet to punish physical attackers or pivots such as U-turn Sneasler and Flip Turn Iron Bundle.

Red Card: Galarian Slowking's good bulk can allow it to pivot into and force out setup sweepers with Red Card, especially those reliant on one-time consumable items such as Booster Energy Iron Valiant and Unburden Sneasler.

Eject Button: Galarian Slowking can utilize its bulk alongside Eject Button to give its teammates a free switch into an opposing Pokemon. Eject Button can also be used to gain momentum against U-turn and Volt Switch users by preventing those moves from switching out the opponent.

Choice Specs and Lagging Tail: Both of these items can be used to cripple an opponent's Pokemon when used with Trick. Choice Specs provides Galarian Slowking with a power boost if it does not have to use Trick immediately, while Lagging Tail can be devestating to an offensive Pokemon like Meowscarada or Greninja.

Tera

Galarian Slowking normally should not be one of your Tera captains, as its natural typing is what enables it to check a wide array of offensive threats. If Galarian Slowking is one of your Tera captains, your main choices for a Tera type are those that cover its main weaknesses, such as Dark to check opposing Ghost- and Dark-types or Grass to check opposing Ground-types. Galarian Slowking already has a wide array of coverage moves and thus is unlikely to require Tera Blast for specific coverage, although it may Tera offensively for the power boost on setup sets.

Draft Strategy

Galarian Slowking is an excellent option if you're looking for a good bulky pivot that can blanket check a variety of opposing physical or special threats and support your offensive Pokemon. Good options for partners you should consider when drafting Galarian Slowking are:

Strong Wallbreakers: Galarian Slowking's ability to bring in strong wallbreakers safely through a slow Chilly Reception and support them with Future Sight can provide them with more opportunities to beat their usual checks. Special mention goes to Ice-type wallbreakers and setup sweepers such as Baxcalibur, Kyurem, and Weavile, that can utilize the snow created by Chilly Reception to gain a defense boost and attack or set up safely.

Fast Pokemon: Due to its very low base Speed, make sure to draft faster Pokemon to partner with Galarian Slowking, as it does not enjoy dealing with strong wallbreakers with attack-boosting natures such as Iron Valiant, Sneasler, and Enamorus. Having fast Pokemon allows you to prevent such Pokemon from running attack-boosting natures unpunished or, if they do, revenge kill them.

Bulky Dark-types: Dark-type pokemon such as Ting-Lu, Kingambit, and Roaring Moon cover two of Galarian Slowking's main weaknesses, while Galarian Slowking can easily switch into Fairy- and Fighting-type attacks aimed at them, forming a very effective defensive core.

Checks and Counters

Ground-, Dark-, and Ghost-types: These pokemon all resist or are immune to one of Galarian Slowking's STAB moves and can hit it super effectively, forcing Galarian Slowking to switch out manually instead of pivoting with Chilly Reception.

Strong Wallbreakers: While Galarian Slowking has good natural bulk and a great defensive typing, certain strong wallbreakers can still break past it even without super effective STAB mons. Examples of these include Choice Band Urshifu-R, Gouging Fire, and Iron Hands.

movesets.name: Specially Defensive Pivot
movesets.description: Galarian Slowking is a fantastic specially defensive pivot in Ubers UU with Future Sight, a great defensive typing for the tier, Chilly Reception, and an excellent utility movepool. Future Sight makes stallbreaking much easier, amplifying wallbreakers like Chi-Yu due to the extra damage it provides. Flamethrower hits Magearna and Solgaleo, which are immune to Sludge Bomb and resist Future Sight. Toxic allows Galarian Slowking to cripple offensive Pokemon trying to switch in, like Palkia-O and Arceus formes, whereas Toxic Spikes allows it to shut down teams lacking a Poison-type while also crippling entry hazard-weak Pokemon like Arceus-Dark and Kyurem-W. Tera Water allows Galarian Slowking to resist Palafin's Water-type moves and handle Palkia-O better while shedding its Ground-type weakness, making it better at taking on Landorus. Alternatively, Tera Grass makes Galarian Slowking resistant to Ground and Water, meaning it still handles Palafin and Palkia-O well, at the cost of being weak to Kyurem-W and Chi-Yu. Lastly, Tera Fairy allows Galarian Slowking to shed its Dark-type weakness, flipping the matchup against Chi-Yu and Arceus-Dark. Galarian Slowking forms good cores with physical walls, which can mitigate its mediocre physical bulk, and as a result, it pairs well with Great Tusk and Giratina. Galarian Slowking can also support less bulky wallbreakers that can struggle to get on the field safely, like Deoxys and Chi-Yu.

movesets.name: Physically Defensive Pivot
movesets.description: Galarian Slowking is one of the best physically defensive pivots in Ubers UU, checking threats like Zacian and Sneasler with its wide support movepool and having the coveted combination of Future Sight and a pivoting move in Chilly Reception. Sludge Bomb allows Galarian Slowking to hit Fairy-types like Zacian and Clefable for good damage while also fishing for poison on Pokemon like Arceus formes. Future Sight assists greatly in breaking stall and makes wallbreakers like Kyurem-W more threatening. Flamethrower hits Steel-types like Magearna and Solgaleo that Sludge Bomb cannot. Slack Off allows Galarian Slowking to recover HP without switching out, letting it poison stall Pokemon like Zacian and Palkia-O and offset entry hazard damage if its Heavy-Duty Boots gets removed by Knock Off. Toxic allows Galarian Slowking to put switch-ins like Arceus formes and Mewtwo on a timer, whereas Toxic Spikes can support its team by spreading status, forcing foes to take passive damage, and poisoning Substitute users like Palkia-O. Tera Water allows Galarian Slowking to resist Palafin's Water-type attacks and handle Palkia-O better; it also removes its Ground-type weakness, making it better at handling Landorus-T. Alternatively, Tera Grass makes Galarian Slowking resistant to Ground- and Water-type attacks, meaning it still handles Palafin and Palkia-O well and is better into Landorus-T, at the cost of being weak to Arceus-Poison. Lastly, Tera Fairy allows Galarian Slowking to shed its Dark-type weakness, letting it take Knock Off and Kowtow Cleave from Great Tusk and Kingambit in a pinch. Galarian Slowking pairs well with Pokemon that struggle to switch in safely, such as Kyurem-W and Chi-Yu, as it can slowly pivot them in. Galarian Slowking is relatively passive and is particularly weak to Mewtwo, Deoxys, and Arceus-Dark, so it forms a very strong core with Arceus-Dark and Zacian, which can check those three foes.

movesets.name: Defensive Pivot
movesets.description:
Galarian Slowking is an amazing defensive pivot due to its stellar special bulk, an amazing ability in Regenerator that allows it to switch into threats like Raging Bolt, Mega Diancie, and Iron Valiant consistently, and the ability to assist its teammates in breaking down the opposing team with Future Sight. Psychic Noise is an alternative to Future Sight, as it allows Galarian Slowking to threaten Pokemon like Iron Valiant and Pecharunt directly while preventing Pokemon like Toxapex and Tapu Koko from recovering, as well as hitting Kyurem and Zamazenta behind Substitute. Chilly Reception allows it to lure in foes like Hisuian Samurott, Urshifu-R, and Roaring Moon while letting in checks to these Pokemon like Zamazenta and Mega Lopunny without receiving damage, giving them opportunities to break, which they wouldn’t have otherwise. This can be especially threatening with Future Sight support, which often puts the opponent in awkward situations. Thunder Wave allows Galarian Slowking to permanently cripple threats like Tapu Lele, Iron Valiant, and Roaring Moon switching into it. Toxic can also fulfill this task, but it is mainly used for targeting bulkier Pokemon like Slowbro and Moltres and setup sweepers like Volcarona and Raging Bolt that leverage their bulk and longevity. Flamethrower allows Galarian Slowking to directly threaten Pokemon like Ferrothorn, Kingambit, and Gholdengo, which would otherwise easily switch into it and remove it. Heavy-Duty Boots helps Galarian Slowking preserve its longevity in the face of entry hazards, as it switches extremely often.

Galarian Slowking fits best on balance and bulky offense teams, which appreciate it bringing in its powerful offensive teammates while offering support by dealing with their checks using either Future Sight or status moves. The main deterrents to Galarian Slowking are Pursuit trappers like Kingambit, Mega Tyranitar, and Weavile, as they can easily switch in and remove it. Therefore, Fighting-types like Urshifu-R, Zamazenta, and Mega Lopunny are near-required. These Pokemon also benefit the most from Galarian Slowking’s Future Sight support, as it commonly lures in Dark- and Steel-types that they can take advantage of. Knock Off absorbers like Great Tusk and Gliscor are also appreciated due to Galarian Slowking's weakness to Knock Off as well as the removal of its Heavy-Duty Boots, which is detrimental to its longevity. Pokemon like Gholdengo, Tapu Lele, and Iron Valiant give Galarian Slowking trouble, as they can all hit it super effectively, so Pokemon that can deal with them like Kingambit, Assault Vest Melmetal, and Ferrothorn are appreciated. Gholdengo in particular can easily switch into non-Flamethrower variants and set up, so Pursuit trappers like Mega Tyranitar and the aforementioned Kingambit work well as teammates. Finally, Galarian Slowking invites in many physical attackers like Landorus-T, Melmetal, and Mega Medicham due to its less than stellar physical bulk, so physical walls like Landorus-T, Zapdos, and Slowbro are appreciated. These Pokemon also offset Galarian Slowking’s weakness to common Ground-types like Great Tusk and Garchomp. In return, Galarian Slowking can deal with Iron Valiant and Mega Diancie for these Pokemon, giving them more chances to break the opposing team.

movesets.name: Assault Vest
movesets.description:
With an Assault Vest, Galarian Slowking leverages its newfound bulk and already solid defensive typing to check threatening special attackers such as Tapu Lele and Volcarona while making use of Regenerator to sustain its longevity versus specially biased mixed threats, chief among them Mega Diancie. Psychic Noise allows Galarian Slowking to shut down Toxapex and Wish from Alomomola while denying any recovery from switch-ins like Gliscor and defensive Heatran. Sludge Bomb's ability to poison its targets allows it to ruin the already entry hazard-weak Tapu Lele and can rack up strong chip on otherwise sturdy answers such as Ting-Lu. Ice Beam is invaluable coverage, chunking other common switch-ins such as Landorus-T, Dragonite, and Mega Latios. Flamethrower is critical for Galarian Slowking, allowing it to hit the Steel-types that ordinarily give it issues like Ferrothorn, Gholdengo, and Kingambit. With 224 EVs in Special Defense, Galarian Slowking is able to survive two Mega Charizard Y Fire Blasts.

Galarian Slowking can function on a wide variety of teams, but it works best on bulky offense teams where it can use its strong bulk and ability to scrap with ordinarily difficult matchups like Tapu Lele and Mega Charizard Y to give its teammates some breathing room. It has some difficulty dealing with offensive Ground-types such as Great Tusk and Landorus-T, so Flying-types such as Zapdos and Moltres that have an outright immunity to Headlong Rush and Earthquake or physically bulky Water-types such as Alomolola and Slowbro that threaten the physically attacking Ground-types with Scald make for great defensive pairings. Dark-types like Kingambit and Hisuian Samurott are the most prevalent issue for Galarian Slowking, so any partners that can handle them such as Clefable and Tapu Fini are greatly appreciated. Without Heavy-Duty Boots, Galarian Slowking can be worn down by entry hazards fairly quickly, so hazard removal in the form of Great Tusk, Terapagos, or Tornadus-T is key to maintaining Galarian Slowking's defensive prowess. Offensively, Galarian Slowking pairs extremely well with hard-hitting physical attackers such as Zamazenta, Ogerpon-W, and Melmetal, which are conversely threatened by the special attackers that Galarian Slowking handles so well. Galarian Slowking appreciates Spikes support to further atrophy the targets getting whittled down by repeated Psychic Noises, making Gliscor and Hisuian Samurott excellent partners, with the former serving to alleviate Galarian Slowking's Earthquake vulnerability and the latter serving as a soft check to various Dark-types and speed control with a Choice Scarf.

movesets.name: Assault Vest (Poison)
movesets.description: Assault Vest Galarian Slowking acts as Poison teams' specially defensive Regenerator wall,easily taking on threats like Choice Specs Latios and Zapdos. Future Sight is used to deal solid damage and create traps that physically attacking teammates such as Sneasler and Okidogi can make use of to break walls such as Blissey and Mega Venusaur, which would otherwise only take Future Sight or the physical hit. Ice Beam hits Flying-types like Enamorus, Zapdos, Landorus, and Thundurus-T. Flamethrower can be run over Sludge Bomb or Ice Beam and can threaten Steel-types like Ferrothorn and Celesteela. Finally, Earthquake beats Heatran, which can be problematic for Poison teams, but should only be used if Galarian Slowking is already running Flamethrower. The given EV spread lets it survive Choice Specs Psyshock from Tapu Lele after Stealth Rock damage. Sneasler and Okidogi pair excellently with Galarian Slowking, using their Fighting-type STAB moves to threaten Dark-types like Hydreigon and Ting-Lu along with specially defensive targets such as Hisuian Goodra and Blissey. They also majorly appreciate Galarian Slowking's Future Sight helping form a devastating combination that can break past physical walls like Mega Venusaur and Great Tusk with ease. Sneasler also appreciates Galarian Slowking as a safe target to pivot into with U-turn against special attackers like Thundurus-T. Alolan Muk complements Galarian Slowking by threatening Ghost-types such as Blacephalon and Gholdengo along with serving as a safe switch-in against Psychic-types like Tapu Lele, which can otherwise break past Galarian Slowking with Psyshock. Crobat provides a solid Ground Immunity and entry hazard removal in Defog, and it also helps deal with foes like Ogerpon-W and Mega Gallade that threaten Galarian Slowking. Mega Venusaur helps by removing problematic Ground- and Water-types like Mamoswine and Dondozo.
